deviceMapping.readmeComment: Use the `clean_rooms` channel with comma separated room ids to clean specific rooms. Resetting the map deletes the saved map with its rooms and zones, so it is not offered as an action; send `action{"did":"actions","siid":10,"aiid":10,"in":[]}` on the `actions#commands` channel to do it.
